references: STM32N6x5, STM32N645xx, STM32N647xx, STM32N655xx, STM32N657xx, STM32N6x5x7xx

sections.text_helper: Section 51.6.11 "MCE fast master key x (MCE_FMKEYRx)" in chapter 51 (Memory cipher engine (MCE)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2444.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x220 + 0x4 * x, (x = 0 to 7)
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Writes are ignored if MKLOCK or GLOCK bit is set in MCE_CR register.
Bits 31:0 FMKEY{32 * x + i}: Fast master key bit (i = 0 to 31)
This key is used by the MCE block cipher in fast mode, if CTXID = 0x0 in MCE_REGCR register.
Register MCE_FMKEYR4 to 7 must be written only if CIPHERSEL=0x3 in MCE_CR, otherwise
FMKVALID may become invalid.
